title: The Wisdome of Solomon (Geneva Apocrypha)
author: Unknown
description: The Wisdome of Solomon from the Apocrypha section of the 1560 Geneva Bible, in the translators' sixteenth-century English spelling with chapter summaries and marginal notes (the extracted text contains OCR errors). The Geneva translators included the Apocrypha but set it apart as useful for edification rather than doctrine. The book, composed in Greek in Alexandria around the first century BCE in the voice of King Solomon, exhorts rulers to love righteousness, teaches the immortality of the soul and the destinies of the just and the wicked, praises personified Wisdom as the radiance of eternal light and the companion of God, and retells the Exodus as Wisdom's work, with an extended critique of idolatry. It is a companion to the library's other Geneva Bible files and to its modern-text Wisdom of Solomon.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
